$comment: Languages each model writes reliably (0.51.0). Pattern rules on the model id, first match wins. "*" = all usual languages. Unknown model = English only until verified (the Models page « Tester la langue » button records a local override in language-settings.json). A model that does not handle the discussion language works in English; its user-facing output is rewritten automatically. Notes are shown in the Models page (French UI).
